title: Message search in the desktop app
spec: The client offers FEATURE_SEARCH and decodes the hits frame (ClientEvent::Hits); ChatSession::search sends Search when the server agreed to it (Unsupported otherwise) and checks the hits match the count; SignedInSession::search returns None from a server without search. Command::Search { query } makes the worker report Event::SearchResults { query, hits } (or Failed(SearchNotOffered)); the app turns it into Update::SearchResults. The window's title bar has a 'Search messages' box and a Search button that send the trimmed query; the results replace the conversation ('Messages matching ...', each as 'author in room: snippet', 'No messages match.' when none), opening one opens its room and closes the results, and Close search returns. End to end against a running server: hits come newest first with author and current text, only from the person's rooms, an edit is found by its new text and a deleted message is not found.
